questions.stem: If it ____ (not rain) tomorrow, we ____ to the park.

options.distractor: if 从句不能用将来时
主句表示将来的结果，要用 will go
rain 是实义动词，否定用 doesn't rain

questions.explanation: 主将从现：if 从句用 doesn't rain，主句用 will go。

questions.stem: I ____ (tell) him the news as soon as he ____ back.

options.distractor: as soon as 从句不能用将来时

questions.explanation: as soon as 引导时间从句用 comes，主句用 will tell。

questions.stem: She ____ (be) very happy if she ____ the exam.

options.distractor: 主句说的是将来的结果
if 从句不能用将来时

questions.explanation: 主句 will be，if 从句用一般现在时 passes。

questions.stem: We ____ (not start) the game until everyone ____ here.

options.distractor: until 从句不能用将来时，主句要用将来时
until 从句不能用将来时
主句说的是将来的动作

questions.explanation: until 引导时间从句用 is，主句用 won't start。

options.text: If it is sunny tomorrow, we will go out.
I'll wait here until he comes back.
We will start when the teacher will come.
If you work hard, you will pass the exam.

questions.explanation: when 从句不能用 will come，应改为 when the teacher comes。

questions.stem: If you ____ (not hurry), you ____ the last bus.

options.distractor: if 从句不能用将来时
主句要用将来时表示结果
if 从句不能用将来时

questions.explanation: if 从句用 don't hurry，主句用 will miss（赶不上是之后的结果）。
